description: This file defines data structures and logic for wake word detection in audio transcripts, including segments, configurations, matches, token normalization, and matching algorithms. It also optionally includes speech transcription segment conversion when the Speech framework is available.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of transcribed wake word or command, including text, timing, and optional range within the transcript.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for wake word detection, including trigger phrases, timing gaps, and minimum command length.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Result of a wake word detection match, including when the trigger ended, post trigger gap, and the detected command.

classes.name: WakeWordGate
classes.description: Contains static methods implementing the core detection logic, normalization, and matching algorithms.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.match
methods.description: Matches trigger words within an audio transcript and segments based on configuration, returning a WakeWordGateMatch if successful.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.commandText
methods.description: Constructs the command text following a trigger end time from transcript segments.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if the given text contains any of the trigger phrases.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger phrases from the beginning of a given text.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.normalizeTriggers
methods.description: Normalizes trigger phrases into tokens for matching.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.normalizeSegments
methods.description: Converts transcript segments into normalized tokens.

methods.name: WakeWordGate.normalizeToken
methods.description: Lowercases and trims punctuation from a token for normalization.
